verses.1: And the serpent was more cunning than all the creatures of the garden. This was because God had created it. God said to the woman, “Even though God has told you not to eat from any tree in the garden, you must still eat from some of those trees.”
verses.2: And the woman said to the serpent, “From the fruit of the tree of knowledge, I will eat.”
verses.3: And from the fruit of that tree, which is in the garden, God said, “Do not eat from it, and do not touch it, or else you will die.”
verses.4: And the serpent said to the woman, “Do not die.”
verses.5: For God knows that on the day you eat from it, your eyes will be opened, and you will become like God—one who knows good and evil.
verses.6: And the woman saw that the fruit of the tree was good for eating. It also pleased her eyes. So she took some of its fruit and ate it. She also gave some to her servant, who also ate it.
verses.7: And their eyes were opened, and they realized that they were indeed in a state of distress. They became angry, and they made themselves into a mess.
verses.8: And they heard the voice of Jehovah God walking in the garden. That day, man and his wife hid from Jehovah God behind the trees in the garden.
verses.9: And Jehovah God called to the man, and he said to him, “Where are you going?”
verses.10: And he said, “Your voice I heard in the garden. It was like a city to me; I felt safe there.”
verses.11: And he said, “Who told you that you are from the tree? You were ordered not to eat from it, yet you still ate.”
verses.12: And the man said to the woman who was given to him: “This fruit that you have given me has been given to me from the tree, and I can eat it.”
verses.13: And the LORD God said to the woman, “What have you done?” And the woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate it.”
verses.14: And Jehovah God said to the serpent, “You have done this shamefully. You are the most base of all animals and all creatures of the forest. You will eat grass for the rest of your life.”
verses.15: And I will bring upon you and upon your wife, and upon your children, and upon their children, great destruction. You will be destroyed, and you will be trapped in a situation where you cannot escape.
verses.16: To the woman, He said, “Many sorrows will be yours. You will give birth to children in sorrow. Your husband will rule over you.”
verses.17: And Adam said, “When you hear the voice of your wife and eat from the tree that she told you not to eat from, then the land will be cursed to you. You will eat from it throughout your lifetime in sorrow.”
verses.18: And the wild plants will grow for you, and you will eat the grass that grows there.
verses.19: In the time of your death, you will eat bread until you return to the earth. For from there you were taken away, just as a bird is taken up into the sky; and to the sky you will return.
verses.20: And the man named his wife Havah, because she was the mother of all living.
verses.21: And Jehovah God made a covenant with man and his wife. He inscribed their names on the tablets of stone.
verses.22: And the LORD God said, “Man should have been like one of us, able to distinguish between good and evil. But now, let him not stretch out his hand and take from the tree of life. Otherwise, he will eat and live forever.”
verses.23: And Jehovah God sent them out of the garden to work in the land that had been taken from there.
verses.24: And He drove out the man from his place, and settled him in the garden of Eden. There He placed the cherubim and the vail, so that they might guard the way to the tree of life.
